name: Grasp of the Undying
description: After being in combat for 3 seconds, your next auto-attack on a champion deals bonus magic damage equal to 2% of your max HP (0.8% for ranged), heals you for 2.5% of your max HP (1% for ranged), and permanently grants 10 bonus HP (4 for ranged).

name: Conqueror
description: Each separate attack or ability hit on enemy champions grants a stack for 6 seconds (max 6 stacks). Per stack: 3-7 AD or 4-11 AP (adaptive). At maximum stacks: gain 9% omnivamp (melee) or 5% omnivamp (ranged). Max stats at level 15: 42 AD or 66 AP + omnivamp.

name: Second Wind
description: After taking damage from an enemy champion, regenerate 6 (+3% of your missing HP) over 10 seconds. Procs on every instance of champion damage — constant healing vs poke.

name: Overgrowth
description: Gain 3 permanent HP for every 8 nearby minions or monsters that die. At 120 minion deaths: gain additional 2.5% bonus HP. Provides ~200-300 bonus HP by late game.

name: Sudden Impact
description: After using a dash, blink, or exiting stealth, gain 7 lethality and 6 magic penetration for 5 seconds. Cooldown: 4 seconds.

name: Bone Plating
description: After taking damage from an enemy champion, the next 3 instances of damage within 1.5 seconds are reduced by 30-60 (scales with level). Cooldown: 35 seconds. Total blocked: 90-180.

name: Cut Down
description: Deal 5-12% bonus damage to enemy champions who have more maximum HP than you. At 1000+ HP difference: ~10-12% bonus damage. Equivalent to a free half-item vs tanks.

name: Perseverance
description: Gain bonus armor and magic resistance that increase over the course of the game. Approximately +10-30 bonus resists by late game.

name: Transcendence
description: Gain bonus ability haste at certain levels (~10-15 total AH). On champion takedown, reduce remaining cooldown of basic abilities (Q/W/E, not R) by 20%.

name: Hextech Flashtraption
description: While Flash is on cooldown, it is replaced by Hexflash. Dash a distance based on charge time (max 2s).

name: Ice Overlord
description: Immobilizing an enemy champion causes 3 beams to form around them, creating ice beneath them for 3 second(s) and slowing enemies inside. The slow lingers on enemies for 1.5 second(s) after they’ve left the ice zone. Gain a protective layer of ice around yourself, increasing your defenses. After a brief delay, the ice explodes, dealing a burst of magic damage around you.

name: Electrocute
description: Hitting an enemy champion with 3 separate attacks or abilities within 3 seconds deals 40-194 (+35% bonus AD)(+20% AP) bonus adaptive damage. Cooldown: 20-13s (scales with level).

name: Fleet Footwork
description: Moving and attacking generates Energize stacks. At 100 stacks, your next auto-attack heals for 15-85 (+20% AP)(+10% bonus AD) and grants 20% bonus movement speed for 1 second. Healing is 100% effective on champions, 20% on minions.

name: Lethal Tempo
description: Attacking enemy champions grants 5-13% attack speed per stack (up to 6 stacks) for 6 seconds. At maximum stacks, exceed the normal 2.5 AS cap. Total bonus AS at max: 30-78%.

name: Zombie Ward
description: Destroying an enemy ward spawns a friendly Zombie Ward at its location that provides vision for 60 seconds. Gain 1.2 AD or 2 AP per Zombie Ward spawned (up to 10 stacks).

description: Gains

name: Nimbus Cloak
description: After casting a summoner spell, gain 15-35% bonus movement speed for 2 seconds. Procs on Flash, Ignite, Exhaust, Heal — any summoner spell.

name: Legend: Alacrity
description: Gains

name: Revitalize
description: Heals and shields you cast are 5% stronger. When the target is below 40% HP, heals and shields are 15% stronger instead. On a 300 shield: +15 normally, +45 on low allies.

name: Phase Rush
description: Hitting an enemy champion with 3 separate attacks or abilities within 3 seconds grants 40-60% bonus movement speed and 75% slow resistance for 3 seconds. Cooldown: 15 seconds.

name: Demolish
description: While within range of an enemy turret, charge up over 3 seconds. At full charge, next auto-attack deals 100 (+35% of your max HP) bonus physical damage to the turret. Cooldown: 45 seconds. At 3000 HP: 1150 damage per proc.

name: Font of Life
description: Impairing the movement of an enemy champion marks them for 4 seconds. Allied champions who auto-attack marked enemies heal for 6 (+1.5% of your max HP). At 3000 HP: 51 HP heal per ally AA.

name: Courage of the Colossus
description: After immobilizing an enemy champion, gain a shield for 50 (+3% of your max HP per nearby enemy champion) for 2.5 seconds. Shield scales with number of nearby enemies.

name: First Strike
description: If you damage an enemy champion before they damage you, deal 9% bonus damage for 3 seconds and gain 5-25 bonus gold based on damage dealt. If the enemy damages you first, First Strike goes on a 25-second cooldown.

name: Arcane Comet
description: Damaging an enemy champion with an ability launches a comet at their location, dealing 30-100 (+20% bonus AD)(+10% AP) adaptive damage after a short delay. Cooldown: 12-8 seconds. Immobilizing or slowing an enemy reduces remaining cooldown by 20%.

name: Unshakeable
description: Gain 10% tenacity and 10% slow resistance. Stacks with Mercury's Treads and Legend: Tenacity for maximum CC reduction.

name: Battle Zeal
description: After taking damage from an enemy champion, gain 8% bonus attack speed for 3 seconds. Cooldown: 2 seconds. Rewards aggressive trading.

name: Eyeball Collector
description: Amplifies champion abilities and stats under domination path.

name: Brutal
description: Gain +7 AD or +14 AP (adaptive) and +2% armor penetration or +2% magic penetration. Pure stat rune — strongest early-game minor rune. No scaling, no conditions — just raw stats from level 1.

name: Botanist
description: Picking up Honeyfruit grants bonus gold and the healing from Honeyfruit is enhanced. Free gold generation from natural map movement.

name: Dark Harvest
description: Damaging a champion below 50% HP deals bonus adaptive damage and permanently increases Dark Harvest damage by 5. Resets on champion takedown. Damage: 20-60 base (+5 per stack)(+25% bonus AD)(+15% AP).

name: Chain Assault
description: Hitting an enemy champion with an active ability applies a mark to them, causing your next 2 attacks or active ability casts against them to deal bonus

name: Last Stand
description: Deal 5-12% bonus damage when below 60% HP. Damage bonus scales linearly — at 30% HP: 12% bonus damage. Synergizes with Death's Dance and lifesteal.

name: Cheap Shot
description: Damaging an enemy champion whose movement is impaired (slowed, stunned, rooted, knocked up) deals 10-50 bonus true damage (scales with level). Cooldown: 4 seconds.

name: Tyrant
description: When damaging a champion below 50% Health, deal (30-50 (

name: Empowered Attack
description: Every 8 seconds, the next attack will be empowered, dealing 35-50 bonus

name: Coup de Grace
description: Deal 5-10% bonus damage to enemy champions below 35% HP. Synergizes with execute abilities (Garen R, Darius R, Infinity Orb crit).

name: Triumph
description: Champion takedowns restore 10% of your missing HP and grant 25 bonus gold. In a team fight with 3 takedowns: 15% max HP healed.

name: Ingenious Hunter
description: Gain 10 (+10 per unique champion takedown) item haste, up to 50 item haste at 5 unique takedowns. Reduces cooldown of item actives and passives (Stasis, Protobelt, Locket).

name: Hubris
description: Scoring a takedown against an enemy champion within 3 second(s) of damaging them grants (5 + 1 per champion kill you've scored)

name: Manaflow Band
description: Hitting an enemy champion with an ability permanently increases your maximum mana by 30, up to 300 bonus mana. After reaching maximum stacks, restore 1% of missing mana every 5 seconds.

name: Empowerment
description: Killing minions grants 0.5 AD or 1 AP (adaptive). Killing monsters grants 2 AD or 4 AP. Killing champions grants 5 AD or 10 AP. Stacks infinitely.

name: Aery
description: Damaging an enemy champion sends Aery to deal 15-70 (+20% bonus AD)(+10% AP) bonus adaptive damage. Healing, shielding, or buffing an ally sends Aery to shield them for 30-140 (+40% bonus AD)(+20% AP) for 2 seconds. Can proc multiple times per fight.

name: Scorch
description: Damaging an enemy champion with an ability deals 20-40 bonus magic damage over 1 second. Cooldown: 10 seconds. Falls off late game.

name: Celerity
description: Gain 3% bonus movement speed. All movement speed bonuses are 7% more effective. Hecarim passive converts bonus MS to AD.

name: Absolute Focus
description: When above 70% HP, gain 5-30 bonus AD or 10-60 bonus AP (adaptive, scales with level). Anti-synergy with melee fighters.

name: Gathering Storm
description: Gain increasing AD or AP as the game progresses. 5 min: +5 AD/+10 AP. 10 min: +10 AD/+20 AP. 15 min: +15 AD/+30 AP. 20 min: +20 AD/+40 AP. Strongest late-game minor rune.

name: Axiom Arcanist
description: Your ultimate ability has 10% increased damage,

name: Legend: Tenacity
description: Gains

name: Relentless Hunter
description: Gain 5 (+8 per unique champion takedown) bonus movement speed while out of combat, up to 45 MS at 5 unique takedowns.

name: Ixtali Seedjar
description: Periodically gain seeds. Place a seed in brush — grows into a vision-granting plant. Very niche — other Slot 3 options usually provide more combat value.

name: Guardian
description: When you or a nearby ally take damage, both are shielded for 70-150 (+25% AP) for 2 seconds. Cooldown: 70-40 seconds (scales with level). Auto-triggers without needing to cast.

name: Nullifying Orb
description: When you take magic damage that would reduce you below 35% HP, gain a shield that absorbs 40-120 (+15% bonus AD)(+10% AP) magic damage for 4 seconds. Cooldown: 60 seconds.
